# A Rich and Active Commerce Between Thoughts and Experiences[^1]

Pragmatism only follows the example of the sister-sciences, interpreting the unobserved by the observed. It brings old and new harmoniously together. It converts the absolutely empty notion of a static relation of 'correspondence' between our minds and reality, into that of a rich and active commerce (that anyone may follow in detail and understand) between particular thoughts of ours, and the great universe of other experiences in which they play their parts and have their uses.

[^1]: [[@Pragmatism - William James]]
